paragraph: Our Granville composite reading prints a moderately constructive 63 out of 100 this morning, completely free of any ominous breadth divergence warnings. This primary verdict is heavily supported by strong equal-weight participation and economic health, evidenced by the RSP/SPY breadth ratio jumping +1.25% and transports leading the broader market with a +2.29% surge over the S&P 500. Macro crosscurrents inject some underlying anxiety into the session, however, as high-yield credit spreads widen to 3.44% and the VIX sits at an elevated 21.15 alongside a notable -3.32% underperformance in bellwether semi-conductors via SOXX. Despite this tech-adjacent drag and some defensive positioning in risk appetites, underlying liquidity remains structurally sound with a stable US Dollar and a benign 10-year real yield locked at 2.60%. Expect a resilient session with a cautiously bullish directional lean as broad-based participation overrides sector-specific tech weakness.
